scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical; exact-rational finite tests are corroboration, not all-dimensional certification. Novelty is best-knowledge with residual unindexed-equivalence risk.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected positively weighted undirected networks, exactly two boundary vertices, real signals, and unweighted complete-pair Gini dispersion. No claim for three or more boundary vertices or nonlinear p-harmonic extension.
title: Sharp Gini norm and equality geometry of two-terminal graph-harmonic extension
